label: sparse mid-original-phase conjunction of token history (prev c/v/t/3, input c/t/j/2/a/y, first token z/c/f/w/o/b)
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase (99% of mass), at steps t=3-6 (peak t=4), on 0.17% of those steps. It never fires in the copy phase and fires only weakly at the delimiter. Activation is enriched for current inputs c/t/j/2/a/y, previous inputs c/v/t/3, the token two steps back c/3, and first tokens z/c/f/w. Each of these is only a soft bias: positional or token predicates reach about 0.9 recall but precision under 1.5%. Stacking the three token-set conditions gives the best dev F1 of 0.23 (precision 0.18, recall 0.30). Missed activations spread across many other token contexts, so this looks like a distributed hash over recent token history with no compact description. The top activations (about 0.2-0.25) come at t=4-5 right after a c input, e.g. w l 3 c c a; this is anecdotal and was not scored separately.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: prev_tok=c (+4.78), prev_tok=v (+4.32), orig0=f (+4.28), prev2_tok=c (+4.24), orig0=z (+4.07), orig0=b (+3.75). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-4.57), in_tok=3 (-4.51), in_tok=b (-4.33), prev3_tok=- (-3.38).
